title: Imperatorin exerts anti-colorectal cancer effects by targeting NOX2 to inhibit mast cell degranulation.
publicationName: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
journalName: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
snippet: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a major global malignancy with a poor prognosis in advanced stages.
